connector.name: TrustNotch
connector.registryDescription: Tamper-evident audit logs for AI agents: submit, fetch, and verify cryptographic proof bundles.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package trustnotch-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.trustnotch, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TRUSTNOTCH_PUBKEYS_PATH
env.description: Path to a local public-key file to pin for independent offline verification.
